$comment: Central package (org, name) -> GitHub repo overrides, for the ~18% of packages where the 'module-<org>-<name>' naming convention doesn't hold. Compiled from this pipeline's design-phase research (verified against the live Central API and GitHub org listing: 90/110 ballerinax java-platform packages matched the convention directly; these are the 20 documented exceptions, grouped by cause).
no_repo: $comment: packages known NOT to map to a standalone repo at all - resolver should record these as unresolved rather than guess wrong, so they surface in scan_status/failures instead of silently vanishing or silently mis-filing an issue.
